concerns.issue: The 'execute <plan>' variant dispatches a subagent that implements changes in a git worktree. This slightly contradicts the 'never modify source code / no mutating operations' rules, though it only runs when the user invokes it explicitly.
Writes files under plans/ (or animation-plans/) and plans/README.md in the project, and runs 'git rev-parse'. All of this is within the project and consistent with the stated purpose.
Fans out multiple read-only subagents for the audit. This is resource usage only. Prompts include an anti-injection rule.
